# Now 2.10.30
- Fixed long song titles disappearing between marquee cycles; scrolling now repeats continuously after its initial pause. - Fixed short titles being unnecessarily truncated by giving the title column its correct layout width. - Made browser playback controls target the exact YouTube Music or Spotify Web tab shown in the overlay. - Prevented LinkedIn, YouTube, and other Chrome media tabs from intercepting play, pause, next, or previous commands.

# Now 2.10.29
- Added a smooth, continuous marquee for song titles that are too long to fit in the overlay. - Short titles remain still, while long titles pause briefly before beginning to scroll. - Marquee motion respects the macOS Reduce Motion accessibility setting.

# Now 2.10.28
- Added automatic recovery from stalled Chrome, AppleScript, and MediaRemote requests without restarting Now. - Serialized browser polling, reused the known music tab, and force-reset stale browser processes after timeouts. - Made Show Overlay restart the monitoring transport while preserving the last valid track. - Added Active/Dock, built-in MacBook, and persistent external-display targeting in Position settings. - Added safe display fallback when a selected monitor disconnects, with automatic restoration after reconnecting.
